notes.title: Update v57.4: Free Camera, New Settings, Content & Optimization
notes.notes:
🕹️ Game

 Added free external camera (fly using ←, →, ↑, ↓ keys; sensitivity (flight speed) is adjusted with the mouse wheel)
 Updated camera tips: in external camera mode, ↓ key sets the camera to the locomotive
 Added view distance setting (in the launcher you can set the desired draw distance with additional parameters)
 Added flickering of VL80T cab lights during traction position changes
 Oncoming train blinks its bright headlight if ours dazzles it with bright light
 Updated coordinates of oncoming train headlights (match real positioning)
 Added different screeching sounds for curves and switches
 Updated fan sound for ChS7 (will be further improved)
 Enabled smoothing for locomotive signal light (allows creating more universal locomotive signal models by reducing polygons)
 Increased draw distance for signal lights
 Fixed malfunction #80 (will be further improved)
 Fixed nose-dip when entering a curve
 Fixed traffic issue from Steam Workshop where models and textures did not match
 Improved display of level crossing signs and brake test points on 2D profile
 Optimized graphics performance
 Added input.ini file for test mode to override key codes


🚆 Content

 Updated rear section of VL80T, added rear cab with control desk
 Updated EPT block for VL80T (improved model and texture)
 Updated sounds for ChS8
 Updated radio lighting for ChS4KVR
 Changed ChS7 number from 065 to 180 (matches Ukrainian registration with speedometer)
 Fixed signal errors and display in Lviv–Stryi route
 Added new DLC — Shepetivka–Lviv route. Built from Shepetivka to Dubno. Construction ongoing.


🛠️ Tools

 Added ZD Receiver — example of accessing game variables for integrations (in Content Editor folder)
 Reduced sensitivity to script file formatting errors in Scenario Editor
 Created a page for suggestions and voting: https://suggest.zdsimulator.com

notes.title: Update v57.3: Sound Improvements, New Features, and Content Updates
notes.notes:
Gameplay 


3D sound effects added 


Improved sound in curves 


Added sound when pantograph breaks 


Fixed issues in locomotive electrical schemes 


Added passing train sound 


Fixed external camera randomly turning off 


Custom wiper support: if wiper.dmd exists in the loco folder, it is used; otherwise, default 


Custom wheelset support: simulator looks for WheelSet.dmd; if missing, uses default 


Fixed frozen traffic wagons when deleted 


Fixed save file placement issue 


Simulator now applies 4GB patch automatically 



Content 


Updated VL80T model 


Added custom pantograph to VL80T 


Opening window added to VL80T 


EPT in VL80T is available if ept.dmd is present in loco folder 


Radiator grilles added for 2M62 and 2TE10U 


Updated headlights for 2M62, 2TE10U and TEM18DM 


Missing display frame added for TEM18DM module 



Tools 


Fixed Steam editor access — now available without a key 



Route Editor 


Fallback font loading from game if not found locally 



Content Editor 


Delete key support added 


“Other” section added for manually uploading custom objects 


Quick folder open button added 


Improved list loading performance 


Updated static section 


Objects on the same track and within 100m now form chains 


Position recalculation by distance (forward/back) added 




New columns: object location, distance from previous, length (if traffic), center-to-center distance (if traffic) 



Traffic Editor 


Special traffic and autofill from base.ini added

notes.title: Update v57.2: Steam Workshop Support, New Scenarios & Gameplay Improvements
notes.notes:
🛒 Steam
Steam Workshop access now available


🕹️ Game
Added support for Steam Workshop content

Red‑Yellow‑White signal now limits speed to 60 km/h

Adjusted pantograph raise speed on CHS series locomotives

Added electric arc sound on neutral sections

Added support for custom pantographs

Custom pantograph and flash effect on CHS4

PONAB (overheated axleboxes) indicator visible at night

Smoothed wagon movement along track gradient

Added autumn textures and seasonal sun position changes

Camera can now move along the train exterior using ← → keys

Added wagon clack sound every 800 m

Profile tooltip shifts up/down when near screen edge

Exit signal shows two green aspect, toggled by flag G

CHS4KVR: added windows, whistle button, compressor lamps, engine compartment model, new headlight, buffer lamps and cab lighting

CHS4, CHS4KVR, CHS4t, CHS7, CHS8: added sounds for reverser handle and traction controller

The sound of movement in curves and wagon clatter accelerates with the train's speed


🛠️ Tools
Released content creation tools:

Content editor

Route editor

Scenario editor

Rosters (consist) editor

Traffic editor

Steam Workshop uploader
🚆 Content
Updated CHS4KVR model:

Fixed shadow artifacts on roofs and body

Added windows in engine compartment

Added railings, door handles, windshield access rail, balcony

New headlight model

Fixed cabin rear wall shadows

Added typhon, sand dispenser, circuit breaker pedals to driver’s footrest


🗺️ Routes
Standardized all signals model

Signal plates moved closer to vertical posts

Added new scenarios for Kyiv–Shevchenko and Kyiv–Shepetivka routes



Thank you for your support! Follow Steam Workshop for new scenarios and content, and join our community!

notes.title: Update v57.1: External Camera, New Sounds, Fixes
notes.notes:
Added external camera mode
 Fixed the CHS4 fan control relay bug
 Fixed speed limit sign overlay on profile
 Removed failures in easy mode from automatic scenarios and multiplayer
 Added random vigilance handle selection
 Added CHS8 compressor vibration
 CHS4 and CHS4KVR: fixed stabilizer and battery currents
 CHS4: added right window opening
 Added pantograph raising and lowering sounds
 Added carriage sounds when the window is open
 In AUTO scenarios: added random diversion to branch tracks
 Improved compressor pressure relay logic: compressor starts earlier when using the whistle or horn
 CHS7: fixed SL2M speedometer backlight
 Semaphore signs shifted closer to the semaphores
 Added conversion of Y, G, D, P, U characters into Cyrillic on static semaphores
 CHS4 now visible in multiplayer
 Changed logic for loading player's train: now consists are added from traffic.ref
 Increased visibility distance
 Fixed multiplayer derailment bug
 Reduced speedometer sound volume in external camera mode

notes.title: Update v56.1: Stability, Signal Letters & Scenario Fixes
notes.notes:
Update  
  
Improved stability, signaling, and scenarios  
This update enhances game stability, adds support for new signals, updates scenarios, and improves multiplayer functionality. Buffer light behavior has also been fixed


General  
  
 Improved stability, bug and crash fixes  
 Added more debugging data  


Locomotives  
  
 Fixed buffer light behavior on ChS4T
 Added buffer lights for 2M62  


Multiplayer  
  
 Fixed signaling logic when moving in reverse  
 Implemented whistle sound transmission from oncoming trains  


Scenarios – fixes and improvements  
  
 Kyiv — Myrhorod (Train 74)  
 Kyiv — Zhmerynka (Train 6001)  
 Kyiv — Shevchenko (Train 3702)  
 Kyiv — Shepetivka (Train 6669)  
 Lviv — Stryi (Train 2125)  


Editor
